title: Role graph generator, policy templater, and runtime permission health-checker
creator: Ava Chen
description: Deliver a Terraform module and companion tooling that generates minimal, auditable IAM role sets from a declarative service access graph, emits policy templates with fine-grained conditions, and runs runtime permission health checks against private deployments. Goals: (1) reduce blast radius by auto-curating least-privilege role bindings per service, (2) provide operators with clear upgrade/rollout guidance and a drift-detection/health-check pipeline, and (3) produce artifacts that are easy to review during security audits.
motivation: Customers deploying Redwood Private need repeatable, reviewable IAM patterns for VPC/on-prem deployments. Current templates are ad-hoc and cause overbroad permissions. This work lowers operational risk for Private customers and speeds audits for SOC/ISO requirements.
implementation_notes: Module will accept a service-to-resource graph (YAML) and produce: role modules, policy JSON templates, and recommended trust relationships.
We will integrate an OPA-based policy linter to assert deny-lists and flag wildcard privileges.
Support cross-account trust templates for Dedicated/private cross-account operators.
Expose Terraform outputs usable by deployment orchestration to wire roles into instance profiles, service accounts, and KMS grants.
acceptance_criteria: Terraform module compiles without errors in example-private-deploy repo
Generated policies pass OPA/sentinel checks with no critical violations
Unit tests cover graph -> role generation cases (service only, service+KMS, cross-account trust)
A sample customer-like deployment applied in staging that demonstrates drift detection alerting when a permission is manually widened
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Overly aggressive automatic restriction could break runtimes. Mitigation: Emit permissive fallback role and opt-in strict mode; CI gate with smoke tests.
Risk: Complex cross-account conditions. Mitigation: Provide templated trust patterns and examples for common cloud providers.

Risk: Terraform state drift making health checks noisy. Mitigation: Health-checker reads live IAM principal policies and compares to rendered expected policies, presenting diff rather than auto-remediation.
tasks: Draft module API and example YAML schema
Prototype role graph walker and policy generator (PoC in Python)
Add OPA rules and policy-lint integration
Write acceptance tests + stage deployment runbook
Create upgrade playbook for customers on older IAM templates
